findings.description: Docker Sandboxes re-resolves saved mount paths when replacing a sandbox container during kit changes or restarting a sandbox. An attacker able to replace a source ancestor in a shared writable workspace with a symlink can redirect another sandbox's mount to a different host directory, exposing its contents and permitting modification through read-write mounts. The destination must remain accessible to the daemon and allowed by policy where enforced. Saved-mount replay during kit replacement was introduced in version 0.35.0; ordinary restart replay was added in version 0.45.0. This saved-mount replay issue is fixed in version 0.54.0.

A flaw was found in the 389-ds-base server. A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the `schema_attr_enum_callback` function within the `schema.c` file. This occurs because the code incorrectly calculates the buffer size by summing alias string lengths without accounting for additional formatting characters. When a large number of aliases are processed, this oversight can lead to a heap overflow, potentially allowing a remote attacker to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or achieve Remote Code Execution (RCE).

Insufficient policy enforcement in WebView tag in Google Chrome prior to 143.0.7499.192 allowed an attacker who convinced a user to install a malicious extension to inject scripts or HTML into a privileged page via a crafted Chrome Extension. (Chromium security severity: High)
A code injection in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile allowing attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.
OS command injection vulnerability exists in ELECOM wireless LAN products. A crafted request from a logged-in user may lead to an arbitrary OS command execution.

A flaw was found in bootc. On a sealed composefs boot with a strict composefs digest on the kernel command line, the initramfs derives fs-verity enforcement from unsigned repository metadata and can mount an image under images/refs without measuring it against that digest. An attacker with offline write access to the root filesystem can boot a modified root under a legitimately signed UKI.

The CubeWP Framework plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.1.32 This is due to the `cubewp_frontend_role_caps()` function, registered on the `user_has_cap` filter, which excludes REST API requests via a `REST_REQUEST` guard but omits a corresponding `XMLRPC_REQUEST` check, causing it to unconditionally widen capabilities for any Subscriber or Contributor on XML-RPC and admin-ajax.php request paths. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers with Subscriber-level access and above to escalate their privileges to the full Contributor role capability set — gaining `edit_posts`, `delete_posts`, and `read` — allowing them to create, edit, and delete posts through core XML-RPC methods such as `wp.newPost`. Critically, the capability widening is not scoped to CubeWP's own submission handlers but applies globally to all core capability gates on affected request paths, meaning any Subscriber account can exploit this with a single standard XML-RPC call and no CubeWP-specific interaction. Successful exploitation causes the attacker's own account to receive every capability defined for the Contributor role.

The plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'custom_text (shortcode attribute of [vc_cta])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The style="classic" shortcode attribute must be used to trigger the vulnerable code path that feeds custom_text through vc_get_css_color into the inline style attribute; wp_kses_post applied at save time does not neutralize the payload because the attacker's value contains no HTML tags, only a double quote inside a shortcode attribute, leaving the injected content intact in post_content.

The Swift Performance Lite plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'REQUEST_URI (gated by $_GET['force-cache'])' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.3.7.5 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The payload is planted via a single unauthenticated GET request to any URL with ?force-cache=1 and a URL-encoded HTML payload in the path, which the plugin decodes and creates as a literal filesystem directory name; the script fires the next time an administrator opens the Swift Performance dashboard.

A vulnerability was found in Undertow, where URL-encoded request paths can be mishandled during concurrent requests on the AJP listener. This issue arises because the same buffer is used to decode the paths for multiple requests simultaneously, leading to incorrect path information being processed. As a result, the server may attempt to access the wrong path, causing errors such as "404 Not Found" or other application failures. This flaw can potentially lead to a denial of service, as legitimate resources become inaccessible due to the path mix-up.

Vulnerability in the Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in for Apache HTTP Server, Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in for IIS).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data as well as  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle HTTP Server, Oracle Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in accessible data. Note: Affected version for Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in for IIS is 12.2.1.4.0 only. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 10.0 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N).
telnetd in GNU Inetutils through 2.7 allows remote authentication bypass via a "-f root" value for the USER environment variable.
OpenClaw (aka clawdbot or Moltbot) before 2026.1.29 obtains a gatewayUrl value from a query string and automatically makes a WebSocket connection without prompting, sending a token value.

An improper neutralization of special elements used in an sql command ('sql injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiClientEMS 7.4.4 may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorized code or commands via specifically crafted HTTP requests.

SiYuan 3.8.8 before 3.8.10 contains an incorrect permission assignment vulnerability that creates workspace directories with mode 0755 and conf.json with mode 0644, exposing the cleartext AccessAuthCode administrator credential. Local users able to traverse the SiYuan user's home path can read it and authenticate as administrator via Basic authentication, for example calling /api/system/setAPIToken to change the API token.

SiYuan from 3.8.6-beta.1 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows read-only publish users (RoleReader) to modify persistent workspace configuration via /api/system/getChangelog. Attackers can send POST requests through the publish service proxy, even anonymously when basic authentication is disabled, to persist ShowChangelog = false to conf.json.

SiYuan before 3.8.11 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers by storing handler-named block attributes such as onmouseover. Attackers can share crafted .sy.zip packages or Markdown files whose attributes reach renderCustom or the unsanitised preview pane, executing OS commands via Node integration in the desktop app.

SiYuan before 3.8.11 uses DejaVu sync code that accepts a non-hexadecimal 40-byte remote index ID from WebDAV responses and joins it into the repository indexes path unchecked, allowing path traversal. An on-path attacker altering plaintext HTTP WebDAV sync responses can overwrite a workspace data file, such as a .sy note, with compressed index data.

LibTIFF is vulnerable to an integer overflow. This flaw allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (application crash) or possibly execute an arbitrary code via a crafted tiff image, which triggers a heap-based buffer overflow.

A NULL pointer dereference flaw was found in vmxnet3_rq_cleanup in drivers/net/vmxnet3/vmxnet3_drv.c in the networking sub-component in vmxnet3 in the Linux Kernel. This issue may allow a local attacker with normal user privilege to cause a denial of service due to a missing sanity check during cleanup.

ezdxf through 1.4.5 contains a code injection vulnerability in the dxf2code add-on that allows attackers to inject Python code via unescaped single quotes in DXF table entry names. Attackers can craft a DXF file whose layer, linetype, style, or appid names break out of quoted strings in generated scripts, executing code with the privileges of the user running them.

torchvision before 0.29.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability in _extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory by supplying crafted tar archives. Attackers controlling archives passed to extract_archive() or download_and_extract_archive() can use .. paths, absolute paths, or symlinks to overwrite Python modules and achieve code execution.

pyfda through 0.9.5 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability in load_filter() that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted .npz or .pkl filter files. Attackers can embed a __reduce__ gadget that runs via np.load with allow_pickle=True or pickle.load before validation, executing code with the user's privileges.

JAL (Just Another Ledger) through 2026.11.3 contains an arbitrary file overwrite vulnerability in backup restore that allows attackers to write files by supplying a crafted .tgz backup with a symlink member. Attackers can include a jal.sqlite symlink to an absolute path followed by a regular jal.sqlite member, overwriting files such as shell startup scripts for code execution.

lastversion before 3.6.20 contains a path traversal vulnerability in extract_tar() that allows attackers to write files outside the extraction directory via tar symlink members. Attackers controlling a project's release assets can craft a tarball with a symlink followed by a file beneath it, writing files like usercustomize.py to achieve code execution.

LibreChat 0.7.6 before 0.8.8 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to block the server event loop by uploading a crafted conversation import file to POST /api/convos/import. Attackers can submit many messages with unresolvable parentMessageId values, triggering quadratic processing in cloneMessagesWithTimestamps or adjustTimestampsForOrdering and stalling the Node.js event loop for minutes for all users.

Video Popup Block by WPZOOM 1.1.2 before 1.1.9 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows Contributor-level users to inject markup via unescaped video URL and popup width values. Attackers can store a block whose .mp4 URL or width breaks out of attributes in frontend.js, executing script in the site's origin when users open the popup.

LibreChat 0.7.8 before 0.8.9 contains a race condition vulnerability in checkBalance that allows authenticated users to obtain multiple auto-refill credits by sending concurrent requests. Attackers can send simultaneous chat requests that each pass the unlocked lastRefill check, receiving repeated refillAmount credits and bypassing configured token credit limits.

InternLM LMDeploy 0.9.0 through 0.18.0 contains an unbounded resource allocation vulnerability in the DistServe proxy /distserve/connection_warmup endpoint that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory. While a prefill/decode connection is pending, for example after registering a slow node via /nodes/add, repeated warmup requests spawn unbounded wait_for_conn() tasks and sockets until the proxy process is killed.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in IdeaBox Creations PowerPack Addons for Elementor powerpack-lite-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects PowerPack Addons for Elementor: from n/a through 3.2.0.
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Themeum Kirki kirki allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Kirki: from n/a through 6.4.2.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in KAP ASIAs LottieFiles – JSON Based Animation Lottie & Bodymovin for Elementor <= 1.10.9 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting include-lottie-animation-for-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects LottieFiles – JSON Based Animation Lottie & Bodymovin for Elementor <= 1.10.9 - Authenticated (Contributor+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting: from n/a through 2.0.3.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in miniOrange miniorange otp verification miniorange-otp-verification allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects miniorange otp verification: from n/a through 5.6.2.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Webful Creations RepairBuddy computer-repair-shop allows Stored XSS.This issue affects RepairBuddy: from n/a through 4.1237.
A code injection in Ivanti Endpoint Manager Mobile allowing attackers to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution.

The App Builder – Create Native Android & iOS Apps On The Flight plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Authentication Bypass via Google ID Token Audience Validation Bypass in all versions up to, and including, 5.7.1. This is due to the `LoginGoogle::login()` function failing to validate the `aud` (audience) claim of the supplied `idToken` against any OAuth client ID belonging to the WordPress site, failing to verify the `email_verified` claim, and resolving WordPress accounts solely by the email claim without binding to the Google `sub` (subject) identifier — while the `/app-builder/v1/login` REST endpoint is registered with a `permission_callback` that unconditionally returns `true`, leaving it fully reachable by unauthenticated requesters. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to authenticate as any existing WordPress user — including Administrators — whose email address is known, by supplying a Google-signed ID token obtained from an entirely unrelated OAuth client containing the target user's email claim, which causes the plugin to issue a signed App Builder JWT granting that user's full privileges. Exploitation requires the attacker to obtain a valid Google-signed ID token carrying the target user's email address, which can be achieved by operating a separate Google OAuth client and inducing the target user to authenticate through it.

Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in object.to_json that allows template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit by serializing into an unbounded MemoryStream. Attackers can repeatedly apply object.to_json to escape-heavy strings in a tiny template, amplifying output to multi-gigabyte heap allocations and causing denial of service.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in the bulkDestroy function that allows authenticated users to delete rows from any workspace table by supplying foreign row IDs. Attackers with TABLE WRITE on one table can send row _id values from other tables to the DELETE /api/:sourceId/rows endpoint, causing data loss and workspace metadata deletion.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table write access to reference other tenants' files by supplying arbitrary attachment keys on row save. Attackers can inject a victim app's attachment key into a row, then update or delete the row to delete that object from the shared APPS bucket or read it via presigned URLs.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Webful Creations RepairBuddy computer-repair-shop allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects RepairBuddy: from n/a through 4.1237.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP GiveWP give allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects GiveWP: from n/a through 4.19.2.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Mohammed Kaludi AMP for WP accelerated-mobile-pages allows Stored XSS.This issue affects AMP for WP: from n/a through 1.1.21.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in DevItems ShopLentor woolentor-addons allows Stored XSS.This issue affects ShopLentor: from n/a through 3.5.9.

A flaw was found in the Keycloak server's client management component. When a client is created or imported with authorization services enabled, the system fails to properly clear an internal session attribute used during the setup process. This allows an authenticated attacker with client management permissions to bypass security controls and upload a malicious JavaScript policy, which is then executed on the server when an authorization request is made. Successful exploitation could allow the attacker to run arbitrary code on the server, potentially compromising the entire system.

A flaw was found in the SAML HTTP-Redirect binding implementation of Keycloak. The issue occurs because the server processes percent-encoded parameter names (like %53AMLResponse) while the signature verification logic only checks literal parameter names. An attacker can use this discrepancy to provide a crafted, unsigned SAML message that the server processes instead of a legitimately signed one, leading to full account takeover of federated users.

A flaw was found in the management interface of the Quarkus framework, specifically within the quarkus-vertx-http component. The issue occurs when the framework incorrectly combines the management root path with specific permission rules, leading to a situation where security policies are applied to the wrong internal paths. As a result, an attacker can bypass intended authorization checks and gain unauthorized access to sensitive management endpoints.

A security vulnerability has been detected in GH05TCREW PentestAgent 0.2.0. This vulnerability affects the function _execute_single of the file pentestagent/agents/base_agent.py of the component Workspace Scope Gate. Such manipulation leads to missing authorization. The attack needs to be performed locally. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
An authentication bypass in Ivanti Endpoint Manager before version 2024 SU5 allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to leak specific stored credential data.

Inappropriate implementation in WebGPU in Google Chrome prior to 145.0.7632.45 allowed a remote attacker to potentially perform out of bounds memory access via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: High)

A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved state management. This issue is fixed in iOS 26.3 and iPadOS 26.3, macOS Tahoe 26.3, tvOS 26.3, visionOS 26.3, watchOS 26.3. An attacker with memory write capability may be able to execute arbitrary code. Apple is aware of a report that this issue may have been exploited in an extremely sophisticated attack against specific targeted individuals on versions of iOS before iOS 26. CVE-2025-14174 and CVE-2025-43529 were also issued in response to this report.

Dell RecoverPoint for Virtual Machines, versions prior to 6.0.3.1 HF1, contain a hardcoded credential vulnerability. This is considered critical as an unauthenticated remote attacker with knowledge of the hardcoded credential could potentially exploit this vulnerability leading to unauthorized access to the underlying operating system and root-level persistence. Dell recommends that customers upgrade or apply one of the remediations as soon as possible.

web-token jwt-framework from 4.2.1 before 4.2.6 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes decryption keys in exception stack traces when JWE tokens are rejected. Attackers can submit crafted JWE tokens so JWELoader and JWEDecrypter record dir, AES key wrapping, PBES2-derived or content encryption keys in logged trace arguments readable by others.

SunEditor from 3.0.0 before 3.4.3 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the codeBlock plugin that allows attackers to inject script via entity-encoded pre language class values. Attackers can store content whose language- class decodes to HTML written via innerHTML into the hover button, executing script when victims hover over the block.

Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a path traversal vulnerability in validateStackPath, which omits the isProtectedPath() check and permits writes to protected system directories. Authenticated users with stacks:edit permission can send a crafted composePath to PUT /api/stacks/[name]/compose to write arbitrary files, such as cron payloads, achieving remote code execution as root.

A security flaw has been discovered in itsourcecode Event Management System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /admin/manage_event.php. The manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.
FileZen contains an OS command injection vulnerability. When FileZen Antivirus Check Option is enabled, a logged-in user may send a specially crafted HTTP request to execute an arbitrary OS command.
An issue in PHPGurukul Employee Leaves Management System (ELMS) Version 2.1 allows a remote attacker to escalate privileges via the password recovery functionality

SiYuan before 3.8.10 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability where WebDAV sync error formatting skips HTML escaping for certain malformed-response errors, passing raw markup to the Electron notification renderer. A network attacker who alters a cleartext HTTP WebDAV response can inject event-handler markup that, when the victim manually starts sync, executes JavaScript with Node integration as the logged-in user.

Parse Server 3.10.0 before 8.6.123 and 9.0.0 before 9.11.1-alpha.4 contains an authentication bypass in the Google Play Games authentication adapter, which does not verify that the supplied player ID belongs to the presented access token. Attackers can sign in with their own Google Play Games credential while claiming another user's player ID to take over that account or link that player ID to their own account.

A vulnerability was identified in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file /HOR/admin/add_room.php. The manipulation of the argument photo leads to unrestricted upload. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

justhtml before 3.17.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability in decode_entities_in_text that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash parsing via non-ASCII Unicode digits in numeric character references. Attackers can submit a payload like &#² in HTML text or attributes, causing an uncaught ValueError from int() that aborts JustHTML() and stream() parsing.

Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass LoopLimit by supplying large JSON input to object.from_json. Attackers can pass a flat JSON array or object with hundreds of thousands of elements, which JsonElementExtensions materializes without loop checks, exhausting CPU and memory.

Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a state isolation vulnerability because TemplateContext.Reset() does not clear the Tags dictionary holding array.cycle and math.random state. Attackers supplying templates to a reused context can observe or influence cycle positions and random sequences across renders, and accumulate unbounded cycle entries to exhaust memory.

Scriban and Scriban.Signed before 7.6.0 allow template authors to bypass the LimitToString string length limit because the string.literal, string.base64_encode, html.escape, html.newline_to_br, html.url_encode, and html.url_escape builtins lack allocation guards. An attacker who can supply a small template can repeatedly call these builtins under the default TemplateContext to force multi-gigabyte allocations and exhaust host memory.

Scriban before 7.6.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows template authors to bypass LimitToString by rendering a ScriptObject with many members. Attackers can supply a small template whose ScriptObject.ToString concatenates large member values without length tracking, allocating multi-gigabyte strings and causing memory exhaustion.

A vulnerability was determined in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Executing a manipulation of the argument Date can lead to sql injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized.

Budibase server from 3.0.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows view users and anonymous visitors to access entire base tables by passing a view id to the /api/:viewId/rows routes. Attackers can read, export, modify, and delete rows outside the view filter, including hidden columns, or read the full table unauthenticated through PUBLIC views.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows workspace-scoped builders to access other workspaces' backups by supplying a foreign backupId. Attackers can substitute predictable backup IDs in backup download, import, update, or delete routes to steal archives, restore victim data into their workspace, or delete backups.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a JSON injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JSON structure into S3 delete and Google Sheets row fields via unescaped template parameters. Attackers can submit crafted parameters to the queries endpoint to add extra Key entries, deleting chosen S3 objects or overriding Sheets row columns.

Budibase Server before 4.0.0 contains an authorization bypass in its single-row read and attachment endpoints, which fetch rows by ID without enforcing the requesting view's row filter. Authenticated users with read access to a filtered view can request GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId or GET /api/:viewId/rows/:rowId/attachment/:columnName with a hidden row ID to retrieve that row's data and attachments.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin Creator or app-builder users to read pending invite bearer codes via GET /api/global/users/invites. Attackers can submit a stolen code with a chosen password to the public /api/global/users/invite/accept endpoint, hijacking invited identities up to global admin.

Budibase from 3.41.0 before 4.0.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to take over password-less global Builder accounts via unverified-email OIDC/SSO account linking. Attackers can assert a victim's email with email_verified=false at a trusted IdP, bypassing the isAccountLinkable allowlist to control all apps, datasources, and automations.

Budibase Server from 3.39.18 before 4.0.0 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to erase MongoDB query filters by supplying __proto__ as a dynamic JSON key in PUBLIC queries. Attackers can send a single request to the query execution endpoint, reducing the filter to {} to read, update, or delete every document in the collection.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve legacy LiteLLM credentials by querying the public settings endpoint. Attackers can send unauthenticated GET requests to /api/global/configs/public to obtain liteLLM.keyId and secretKey, enabling unauthorized use of tenant LiteLLM resources.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a server-side template injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with table read permission to execute JavaScript by injecting Handlebars js helpers into row search query values. Attackers can submit base64-encoded JavaScript through the search endpoint, which enrichSearchContext() runs in an isolated-vm sandbox, to read OAuth2 access and refresh tokens of SSO users or cause denial of service.

Budibase before 4.0.0 contains a query injection vulnerability that allows low-privilege or anonymous users to inject AQL or SQL by supplying unescaped parameters to ArangoDB and Snowflake queries. Attackers can execute published queries with crafted parameter values to bypass filters, read entire datasources, and modify or delete all stored documents.

The Apache Airflow TaskFlow decorators @task.bash, @task.sql, @task.analytics, @task.kubernetes_cmd and the common.ai decorators (@task.llm, @task.agent, @task.llm_sql, @task.llm_branch, @task.llm_file_analysis, @task.llm_schema_compare) rendered Jinja templates a second time after the task runner had already rendered them, so any value copied into env, op_args, op_kwargs or the returned prompt, command or SQL was evaluated as a template on the worker. An attacker who can only trigger a Dag run (for example a user with trigger permission supplying run conf), or who controls text that a Dag passes into one of these decorators as an argument or prompt (for example a ticket or a downloaded document), could run arbitrary commands on the worker and read connection passwords and Variables, in any deployment that uses an affected decorator in a Dag that passes such input through env, parameters or prompt. Users are recommended to upgrade apache-airflow-providers-standard to 1.22.0, apache-airflow-providers-cncf-kubernetes to 11.0.0, apache-airflow-providers-common-sql to 3.0.0 and apache-airflow-providers-common-ai to 1.2.0 or later.

A vulnerability was found in SourceCodester Basic Hotel Online Reservation System 1.0. The affected element is an unknown function of the file add_reserve.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument room_id results in sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

A flaw was found in maestro. A remote attacker could exploit a misconfiguration in the gRPC server where authentication defaults to a 'mock' mode. This default setting bypasses all authentication and authorization, allowing an unauthorized attacker to write resource bundles. Consequently, this could lead to arbitrary code execution on managed clusters.

The AWP Classifieds plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'display_name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 4.4.10 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The injected payload is stored as a literal entity-encoded string in the WordPress display_name field, which esc_html() passes through without re-encoding due to its double_encode=false behavior, allowing the browser to decode it to raw markup before the JavaScript sink consumes it.

The WP Go Maps – Google Map, OpenStreetMap, Leaflet & Store Locator plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'query' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 10.2.05 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has enabled the plugin's 'Enable Dynamic SQL Refactors' setting and that the database server is running with a sql_mode containing NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES; neither condition is enabled by default.

vLLM 0.16.0 before 0.21.0 leaks token data between users when the V1 model runner uses async scheduling with pipeline parallelism, because non-last pipeline ranks never write generated tokens to token_ids_cpu and reset num_tokens_no_spec each step. When the fallback path is triggered, such as by mixed prefill/decode batches, stale tokens from a prior request in the same batch slot become model input and are written to the KV cache, exposing fragments of one user's context in another user's response.

vLLM 0.3.0 before 0.30.0 contains a response amplification vulnerability in the OpenAI-compatible API server's shared RequestValidationError handler, which renders every Pydantic validation error, each of which can include the full offending input, in its HTTP 400 response. Unauthenticated attackers can send a malformed request to endpoints such as POST /v1/responses to trigger a disproportionately large error response that consumes server CPU and memory and can disrupt downstream clients and proxies.

A flaw was found in Quarkus. This issue occurs when receiving a request over websocket with no role-based permission specified on the GraphQL operation, Quarkus processes the request without authentication despite the endpoint being secured. This can allow an attacker to access information and functionality outside of normal granted API permissions.

vLLM 0.21.0 before 0.28.0, when using the V1 model runner, contains a state aliasing flaw in ThinkingBudgetStateHolder.sync_batch(), whose SWAP branch copies thinking-budget state to the destination batch row without removing the source entry. Attackers submitting requests with thinking_token_budget can force the reasoning-end token sequence into a concurrent co-batched request's output during a mixed batch reorder.

SiYuan 3.7.0 before 3.8.11 contains a DOM-based cross-site scripting vulnerability in the AI agent chat panel, which renders final and saved assistant replies into innerHTML without HTML sanitisation. Attackers influencing model replies via indirect prompt injection or a configured model endpoint can inject event-handler markup, executing OS commands through Node.js integration in desktop local-kernel mode.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Cerebras ModelZoo up to d76e028d6a5f784954b1329b3ae44721ca8da36a. Affected is the function StreamingShardedHFReader of the file src/cerebras/modelzoo/tools/checkpoint_converters/streaming_checkpoints.py of the component Checkpoint Converter. The manipulation of the argument weight_map leads to path traversal. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A weakness has been identified in sgl-project SpecForge 0.2.0. This impacts the function Eagle3DraftModel.load_embedding of the file specforge/modeling/draft/base.py of the component Draft Embedding Loader. Executing a manipulation can lead to path traversal. The attack can only be executed locally. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called d8a0d78e071199563ef19d9171052096dec89f71. It is advisable to implement a patch to correct this issue.

A flaw was found in Submariner. In its default Pre-Shared Key (PSK) mode, all gateways within a broker set utilize the same PSK. An attacker, by knowing this shared PSK, can forge an Endpoint Custom Resource (CR) to impersonate another cluster's identity. This enables the attacker to establish an Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) tunnel under the false identity, leading to a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack on network traffic between clusters.

A security flaw has been discovered in Tencent RapidJSON up to 1.1.0. This affects the function Writer::WriteString in the library include/rapidjson/writer.h. Performing a manipulation of the argument length results in integer overflow. The attack may be initiated remotely. The patch is named 297637bc0a0f00dc504dbc1a47ebdaa577f8ae19. To fix this issue, it is recommended to deploy a patch.

The User Registration & Membership – Free & Paid Memberships, Subscriptions, Content Restriction, User Profile, Custom User Registration & Login Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'user_registration_<checkbox_field_name>[]' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 5.3.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The self-registration endpoint (wp_ajax_nopriv_user_registration_user_form_submit) requires no nonce, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to create a Subscriber account and then supply the malicious checkbox value through the authenticated profile-update action using a legitimately obtained nonce.

The SlimStat Analytics plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'filter_array' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 6.1.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires a non-default administrator configuration in which the can_view whitelist contains at least one username of which the attacker's login is a substring (e.g., can_view set to 'trustedreporter' while the attacker's login is 'report'), and the stored payload only fires when an administrator subsequently opens the Saved Filters dialog.

The WP Photo Album Plus plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'upn-name' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 9.3.06.002 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires the plugin's Frontend Edit feature to be enabled by the site administrator, which allows photo owners to update photo names via the update-photo-new REST endpoint.

The wpForo Forum plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'nickname / display_name (via WP core profile form); thread[body] carries the [quote data-userid=..] trigger' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 3.2.4 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. Exploitation requires that the site administrator has disabled the profiles.mention_nicknames setting (which is off by default), causing apply_quotes() to use display_name rather than a sanitized nickname when building the data-mention attribute.
A heap overflow flaw was found in 389-ds-base. This issue leads to a denial of service when writing a value larger than 256 chars in log_entry_attr.
